title: v0.0.0 - Framework Bootstrap & CI Setup
description: Initial project setup with Maven structure, GitHub Actions CI pipeline, TestNG integration scaffold, folder architecture, and baseline configuration files.

title: v0.1.0 - First Playwright Execution Layer
description: Integration of Playwright with Java 21 and TestNG. Implementation of first UI test (TC_001), browser lifecycle management, and basic assertion validation.

title: v0.2.0 - Core Utilities & Configuration Engine
description: Browser factory implementation, configuration manager using properties files, environment handling, logging setup with Log4j2, and screenshot utility foundation.

title: v0.3.0 - Page Object Model Architecture
description: Implementation of BasePage, reusable UI actions, locator strategy standardization, page object structure, and custom exception handling framework.

title: v0.4.0 - Data-Driven Testing Layer
description: Integration of external test data sources using Excel (Apache POI) and JSON (Jackson). Implementation of TestNG DataProviders for parameterized execution.

title: v0.5.0 - Advanced Playwright Capabilities
description: Network interception, API mocking, authentication state persistence, and browser session management enhancements for modern web application testing.

title: v0.6.0 - Visual Regression Testing Layer
description: Implementation of screenshot-based validation, baseline image management, and visual comparison strategy for UI regression detection.

title: v0.7.0 - Parallel Execution & Cross Browser Engine
description: Enable parallel test execution using TestNG, support for Chromium/Firefox/WebKit, and thread-safe execution design for scalability.

title: v0.8.0 - Stability & Failure Handling Layer
description: Implementation of TestNG RetryAnalyzer, ITestListener, automatic failure screenshots, retry strategy (max 3 attempts), and enhanced logging system.

title: v0.9.0 - Reporting & Observability Layer
description: Integration of Allure reporting with attachments, execution metadata, screenshots, logs, and CI report publishing configuration.

title: v1.0.0 - Stable Framework Release
description: Final production-ready release including documentation, code refactoring, CI/CD stability, sample test suite, and tagged GitHub release.
